docs(pdt42): finish the MVP (D8)

## Intent

Whether one person can run the platform alone changes a lot over time, from the initial investment to operation. So it is no decision criterion for the MVP, but an aspect for building the solution.

## Key changes

- The first draft no longer has the assumption about running the platform alone.
- The development plan records it as an aspect for building the solution and marks D8 done.
- D8 validates without findings.
